translations.web: but the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to Yahweh, as a devoted field. It shall be owned by the priests.
translations.bsb: When the field is released in the Jubilee, it will become holy, like a field devoted to the LORD; it becomes the property of the priests.
translations.kjv: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the LORD, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest's.
translations.asv: but the field, when it goeth out in the jubilee, shall be holy unto Jehovah, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest's.
